candidates.change_summary: Delete the statement `MinSum = _val;` so SetMinSum never updates MinSum.
Replace `MinSum = _val;` with `MinSum = 0;` so MinSum is always set to zero.
Delete the `if(intitalized)revert();` guard so SetMinSum can still modify MinSum after initialization.
Delete the initialization guard so SetMinSum can be called again after initialization, changing MinSum afterwards.
Set MinSum to _val + 1 instead of _val, so the stored value differs after any successful call.
Invert the reentrancy check so nonReentrant_ always reverts, making SetMinSum fail and leaving MinSum unchanged.
Remove the intitalized guard so SetLogFile can be called after initialization, allowing LogFile to be changed post-init.
Remove the assignment so LogFile is never set and remains the zero address.
Store msg.sender cast to Log instead of the _log argument, so LogFile records a different address.

Drop the require(!locked_) check so the SetLogFile call can proceed even while the lock is held (e.g., during reentrancy from LogFile.AddMessage in a prior state), changing whether LogFile gets assigned.
Remove the reset of locked_ after the function body so all subsequent SetLogFile calls revert once one nonReentrant_ function runs, leaving LogFile unchanged.
